content.comment_body: The LAD diagram workspace seems smaller than the FBD diagram workspace, making it challenging to add more functions side by side. Only vertical stacking is possible, but FBD provides greater horizontal space. Looking for a solution to this issue.
Try using the "Page Layout" button. It works for both LAD and FBD diagrams. See attached reference.
Oh, is that where it is? I was looking for it in the menu bar. Thank you again [user_name].

analysis.insight_summary: Users point out that the ladder diagram workspace in [product_name] software offers less space than the function block diagram workspace, making horizontal expansion difficult. There is also reduced discoverability for layout settings within the interface.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want a consistent and easily adjustable workspace for all diagram types in the software, as well as intuitive access to page layout options.
